description: Enumerate connected intervals, filter overlapping intervals, and emit their strong-interval inclusion tree.

source.title: Common Interval Decomposition Tree
source.reference: Library Checker task; Bui Xuan, Habib, and Paul, ISAAC 2005, LNCS 3827, pp. 146-155, DOI 10.1007/11602613_16
source.algorithm_attribution: Bounded exhaustive strong-interval construction from the published task definitions; O(n^4) time and O(n^2) storage.

output.encoding: Little-endian i64 vector [X, parent_0, left_0, right_0, type_0, ...]; intervals are inclusive; root parent is -1; 0=linear and 1=prime.

workspace.meaning: Maximum serialized tree output; internal interval flags and tree records use fixed bounded arrays.

contract.connected_interval: The permutation values at positions left..right form a consecutive integer interval.
contract.strong_interval: A connected interval that overlaps no other connected interval.
contract.tree: The Hasse diagram of strong intervals under inclusion.
contract.node_type: A node is linear iff every nonempty consecutive union of its children in ascending left-end order is connected; otherwise it is prime. Leaves are linear by vacuity.
contract.node_order: Decreasing interval length, then increasing left endpoint; strict containers therefore precede children.
contract.complexity: O(n^4) worst-case time and O(n^2) auxiliary storage; this bounded exhaustive profile does not implement the official-scale linear-time construction.
contract.error_results: Malformed input returns -1. Null output or insufficient capacity returns -2 without writes.

oracle_method: The oracle uses explicit value sets for connectedness. The certificate validator checks strong-interval membership, direct Hasse parents, complete child coverage, and linear/prime labels without requiring the port's canonical node order.
